input.answer: The fastMRI knee dataset provides raw MRI k-space measurements together with reconstructed DICOM images, and these data concern knee examinations; the dataset is shared to support research on accelerated MRI reconstruction [PMC:PMC6996599].

sources.text: Demonstration summary of the fastMRI knee dataset paper: fastMRI shares raw MRI k-space measurements and reconstructed DICOM images to support research on accelerated MRI reconstruction.
